title: Features that Matter
subtitle: Built for productivity, designed for simplicity

features.title: Create Shortcuts Instantly
features.description: Define your own triggers like email;; or intro;; and expand them into full phrases with a single keystroke. No setup hassles just add, save, and type less.
features.details: Simple trigger format (word;;). Works everywhere you type. Save time by reusing your most common text.

features.title: Smart Cursor Placement
features.description: Place your cursor exactly where you need it after expansion using the ${|} marker. Perfect for filling in names, dates, or custom details without breaking your flow.
features.details: ${|} marker puts the caret inside your snippet. Keeps typing seamless in forms, emails, or docs. Supports literal ${ with \${} escape.

features.title: Manage Your Snippets with Ease
features.description: Quickly search, copy, edit, or delete snippets right from the popup. Stay organized and find what you need in seconds.
features.details: Lightning-fast search. One-click copy to clipboard. Edit or delete anytime. Always synced across Chrome.

additionalFeatures.title: Chrome Sync
additionalFeatures.description: Automatically sync your shortcuts across all your Chrome browsers

additionalFeatures.title: Export & Import
additionalFeatures.description: Backup and restore your shortcuts anytime

additionalFeatures.title: Smart Keyboard Support
additionalFeatures.description: Works with international keyboards and special characters
